title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans, Grafana dashboard panels, and alert tuning
author: Maya Thompson
description: Adds token-level KV cache observability: new metrics emitted from the serving runtime, tracing spans for request lifecycle including cache lookup/serve/evict, Grafana dashboard panels for cost and latency per token (p50/p95/p99), and tuned alert rules to reduce noise while catching regressions. Motivation: several incidents and paging noise from token-cost spikes and noisy cache-miss alerts (linked SUP-9082) showed we needed higher-fidelity signals at the per-token and per-KV-hit level. This PR implements: 1) runtime metric additions (token_latency_ms, token_cost_usd, kv_cache_hit, kv_cache_miss, kv_cache_latency_ms) with tags: model, region, route, quantization_profile; 2) tracing spans around cache lookup/insert and model forward to correlate cache hits with end-to-end latency; 3) Grafana dashboard JSON with new panels for token cost breakdown, cost per route/model, cache hit-rate heatmaps, and request traces links; 4) Prometheus alert tuning: replace single token-cost alert with two alerts (token-cost-regression for sustained p95 increase, token-cost-noise for short spikes) and new cache-miss-rate alert with a higher threshold and longer evaluation window to avoid false positives; 5) docs and migration notes for downstream consumers. The description below contains the checklist and known follow-ups. Checklist: - [x] Add metric emitters and tags in runtime - [x] Add tracing spans and correlation ids - [x] Add Grafana dashboard and import script - [x] Add Prometheus alert rules and tests - [x] Update docs/observability.md with examples - [x] Run canary in staging and monitor noise for 48h Follow-ups: - Evaluate cost-per-token normalization for multi-stage pipelines (ENG-3550) - Add automatic alert suppression during canary rollouts - Add SDK helper for linking traces in dashboard panels
commits: feat(observability): emit token_latency_ms and token_cost_usd from runtime
feat(tracing): add spans for kv_cache:lookup, kv_cache:insert, model:forward
chore(dashboards): add token-kv Grafana JSON and import script
test(alerts): add unit tests for Prometheus alert rules and CI validation
review_comments: Ethan Park: Can we keep tags consistent with existing request-level metrics? Request-level uses 'route' and 'env' — please add 'env' to the token emitters.
Maya Thompson: Added 'env' tag to the token emitters and updated docs; also ensured the tag is low-cardinality (env, region, model, route, quant_profile).
Sofia Rivera: Alert thresholds look reasonable, but I suggest evaluating a 30m window for the p95 regression alert in addition to the 1h window to catch fast regressions.
Maya Thompson: Tuned the p95 regression alert to 30m/1h dual-window evaluation and added rationale in the alert comment.
Liam O'Connor: CI flake on tests/alerts/test_token_kv_alerts.py — looks nondeterministic; added a retry fixture. After rerun CI is green.
SRE Team (comment): After 24h in staging the cache-miss alert fired during a rolling deploy; lowered sensitivity during rollouts and added suppression label in the alert rule.
Approvals: Ethan Park approved, Sofia Rivera approved, Liam O'Connor approved.
release_notes: Observability: token-level KV cache metrics and tracing added. New Grafana dashboard panels for token cost/latency and cache hit-rate. Prometheus alerts tuned to reduce noise while detecting sustained regressions. Migration: update any downstream dashboards to use the new token_* metrics and add env tag where applicable.
